title: Factorization through refined components
statement: With X, K, C, ι, isoC, U_i and g as in the signed-partition construction [lem-sc-constant-subsheaf-positive-refinement-data], any PositiveRefinementData record d (including the disjoint partition, coverage, zero restriction, and signed component equations) admits a map l from the original coproduct of j_(U_i)! Z to the coproduct of j_(d.A_j)! Z such that l followed by Sigma.desc d.f equals g. The positive unit-value fields alone would not imply this conclusion.

proof.text: On each U_i glue in the new coproduct the zero section on Z_i and sign_j times the unit of the j-th summand on A_j with parent j = i. Coverage and disjointness make this a compatible covering family. Send the old integer unit to that glued section using sheafification, the slice extension and the restriction counit, and take the coproduct of the resulting maps. Under Sigma.desc f the unit image restricts to s_i on every partition piece by the signed and zero equations, hence equals s_i by sheaf separation. A map from j_U! Z is determined by its unit section: integer multiplication and naturality determine the constant presheaf map, local integer representatives determine the sheafified map, and the slice direct-sum injections determine the extension map. Thus the old components agree with the composite, and coproduct extensionality proves the factorization.

proof_origin.place: First proof paragraph; explicit factorization by gluing and the universal property of extension by zero.

theorem positive_refinement_factor
    (X : TopCat.{u}) (K C : Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X) (ι : K ⟶ C) [Mono ι]
    (isoC : C ≅ (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) (m : ℕ) (U : Fin m → Opens X)
    (g : (∐ fun i => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (U i)).obj
      ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (U i)))
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) ⟶ K)
    (d : PositiveRefinementData X K C ι isoC m U g) :
    ∃ l : (∐ fun i => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (U i)).obj
          ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (U i)))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) ⟶
          (∐ fun i => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (d.A i)).obj
          ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (d.A i)))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))),
      l ≫ Sigma.desc d.f = g
